subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 1s from any number between 1 and 10 (weeks 1-4) and between 1 and 20 (weeks 5-10); describe the sequence

show.line: After ten we keep going! Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty.

rounds.prompt: Count on with me. Ten, eleven, twelve. What comes next?
What comes next? Fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, and then?

rounds.praise: Yes! A one and a two make twelve.

rounds.prompt: Count the beads on the string. How many?
Count backwards. Twenty, nineteen, eighteen, and then?
Which number comes just before twenty?

hints: Teen numbers come after ten. Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.
Look at the number track. Each step is one more.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count from twelve.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot fourteen. Twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen!

parent_line: Can count forwards and backwards to 20 and read numbers to 20.
